title: The Paycheck Gap
subtitle: How to Turn Your Savings Into a Retirement Paycheck You Can Count On
author: Jordan Ellis
isbn: KDP free ISBN (or the advisor's own Bowker ISBN for an imprint name)
description_html:
You saved for thirty years. Nobody showed you how to turn it into a paycheck.

Most good savers reach retirement with a number, not a plan. They check the balance, feel a knot in their stomach, and still can't answer the only question that matters: how much can we actually spend?

The space between the number you saved and the paycheck you need has a name: the Paycheck Gap. In this short, practical book, retirement income planner Jordan Ellis shows you how to see your own gap on one page and what to do about it.

Inside, you'll discover:

  • Why a big savings number isn't the same as a retirement paycheck
  • The three risks that can quietly shrink your income, and how planners address them
  • A simple worksheet to find your own Paycheck Gap in about twenty minutes
  • The five steps of the Retirement Paycheck Blueprint, explained in plain English
  • The questions to ask any advisor before you hire them

Every chapter ends with one worksheet and one small action, with printable copies online.

This book is educational and is not individualized financial, tax, or legal advice.

If you are within ten years of retirement, start here.
